name: DEI
fix_description: In burnFrom, the allowance check reads _allowances[_msgSender()][account] (msg.sender allowance TO account) instead of _allowances[account][_msgSender()] (account allowance TO msg.sender). The direction is reversed. This allows anyone to burn tokens from any account by simply approving that account first. Fix: change to _allowances[account][_msgSender()].
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct exploit with only a few steps: abuse DEI's broken burnFrom/transferFrom behavior on the pair, call sync to update reserves, then swap out USDC. It requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning and no flash loans, routing, or complex state interactions.
